contract.exact_statement_tested: There exists a learning problem whose replace-one loss increment is bounded by beta H(z_i,z_i') with finite Lp moment for some p>=2, while no finite deterministic uniform-stability bound exists.
contract.domain: m>=1 real-valued training samples, Z_i iid standard normal
acceptance: derive the replace-one inequality for arbitrary real samples
exhibit a quantified family defeating every finite uniform bound
halved-beta and Cauchy controls are rejected

non_circularity: The witness and p=2 moment are selected independently of any numerical tolerance or theorem bound.
